text: Planning a trip can be exciting but also a little stressful. You need to choose a destination, book tickets and pack your bags. When you travel, you experience new cultures, meet different people and try delicious local food. Sometimes you face language barriers, but simple words and gestures usually help. I once got lost in a small town and a kind local showed me the way. These moments teach you to be patient and open-minded. In the end, travel gives you unforgettable memories that stay with you forever.
